players.bio: Pedro Alexis Canelo (born 3 February 1992) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Argentine Primera División club Lanús. Career Chiapas F.C. On 5 January 2016, Canelo joined Chiapas of Mexico for an undisclosed fee. Toluca Canelo joined Deportivo Toluca for the Liga MX Clausura 2017 after former striker Enrique Triverio joined Racing Club de Avellaneda of Argentina.

Carlos Daniel Auzqui (born 16 March 1991) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for Atlético Tucumán. Career On 12 February 2022, Auzqui signed for Nemzeti Bajnokság I club Ferencvárosi TC. On 5 May 2023, he won the 2022–23 Nemzeti Bajnokság I with Ferencváros, after Kecskemét lost 1–0 to Honvéd at the Bozsik Aréna on the 30th matchday.

Clever Domingo Ferreira Ñamandu (born 20 February 2003 in Ypané) is a Paraguayan footballer who plays as a defender for Atlético Tucumán in the Argentine Primera División. Career Sportivo Ameliano Ferreira made his debut in the first division in Sportivo Ameliano, in 2024, in a match corresponding to the Apertura Tournament against Sportivo Luqueño.

Diego José Erroz (born 21 September 1978) is a former Argentine association football midfielder and current coach. Erroz was born in Berrotarán, Argentina, and currently works as coaching staff for Atlético Tucumán of the Primera B Nacional in Argentina.

Alessio Ezequiel Naim Ham (Arabic: إزيكييل هام; born 10 March 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Argentine Primera División club Unión Santa Fe. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Syria national team.

Franco Nicola Albanell (born 18 April 2002 in Montevideo) is a Uruguayan footballer who plays as a striker for Atlético Tucumán in the Argentine Primera División. Career City Torque Nicola made his debut at Montevideo City Torque in 2022, in Uruguay's first division.

Gabriel Carlos Compagnucci (born 29 August 1991) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right midfielder for Belgrano. Career Sportivo Belgrano were Compagnucci's first senior club, he featured once for them in the 2010–11 Torneo Argentino A.

Gastón Suso (born 12 March 1991) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Gimnasia LP. Career Suso's career began in 2013 with Atlético de Rafaela. He didn't make a league appearance for the club, but did feature once during a Copa Argentina defeat to San Lorenzo on 19 June 2013.

Gianluca Ferrari (born 30 June 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentine Primera División club Atlético Tucumán, on loan from Godoy Cruz. Career Ferrari's career got underway in Italy, with the defender featuring for Scandicci's youth teams; in which time he was loaned out to Latina's ranks. In 2016, Ferrari completed a move to Serie D's Montecatini.
Guillermo Gastón Acosta (born 31 October 1988) is an Argentine footballer who plays right winger, midfielder or extreme right. He currently plays for Atlético Tucumán.
Ignacio Galván (born 6 September 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back for the Argentine Primera División club Defensa y Justicia, on loan from Racing Club.
Julián Rodrigo Fernández (born 22 March 1995) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Chilean club Palestino.

Kevin Ortiz (born 18 September 2000) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Atlético Tucumán, on loan from Rosario Central in the Argentine Primera División. Career Rosario Central In February 2021, Ortiz signed his first contract with Rosario Central keeping him at the club until December 2022. He spent time working under Germán Rivarola in the reserves of Rosario.

Lautaro Agustín Godoy (born 15 March 2003 in Monte Grande, Buenos Aires) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Atlético Tucumán in the Argentine Primera División. Career River Plate Godoy was formed in the lower divisions of River Plate, where he played until reserve, but he could not make his debut in the first division.
Leandro Nicolás Díaz (born 6 June 1992) is an Argentine football forward. He currently plays for Atlético Tucumán.

Leonel Di Plácido (born 28 January 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Botafogo, on loan from Lanús. Club career Di Plácido started his professional career in Floresta, Buenos Aires with then-Primera División club All Boys in 2013, however his first appearance for the team came in 2014 in a league defeat against Newell's Old Boys.

César Leonel Vega (born 8 January 2004 in San Miguel de Tucumán) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Atlético Tucumán in the Liga Profesional. Career Atlético Tucumán Vega was trained in the lower divisions of Atlético Tucumán.

Martín Nicolás Benítez (born 17 June 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Argentinian club Atlético Tucumán. Club career Benítez playing for América Mineiro in 2024 Benítez began playing football in his home town team called The Picada. He caught the eye of Boca Juniors who offered a trial that never materialized.
Maximiliano Agustín "Maxi" Villa Pereira (born 3 March 1997) is an Uruguayan footballer who plays as a defender for Montevideo City Torque.

Nicolás Emanuel Laméndola (born 12 December 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Atlético Tucumán. Career Laméndola came through the youth ranks at Atlético Tucumán. He was promoted into their senior set-up in early 2020, as he appeared on the substitute's bench for a Primera División home draw with Lanús on 22 February.

Lucas Ayrton "Pocho" Román (born 10 February 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for FC Cartagena on loan from Primera Federación club Barcelona Atlètic. Born in Argentina, he has represented both Argentina and Italy in their youth teams.

Renzo Iván Tesuri (born 7 June 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Atlético Tucumán. Career Juventud Unida were Tesuri's first club. He made his professional debut at the age of seventeen, playing the last ten minutes of a Torneo Argentino A defeat to Central Norte on 24 November 2013.

Ramiro Ruiz Rodríguez (born 21 March 2000) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Atlético Tucumán. Professional career Ruiz Rodríguez made his professional debut with Atlético Tucumán in a 2-2 Argentine Primera División tie with Lanús on 23 February 2020. He scored his first professional goal against Racing Club de Avellaneda on November 1, 2020.
Tomás Durso (born 26th February 1999) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a Goalkeeper for Atl.Tucumán on loan from Gimnasia LP.
